signals.text: 1 open PM role across 1 US office

bullets: Proactively identify product, contract, and market-expansion opportunities.
Prepare and submit product proposals to customers, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with all regulatory requirements.
Work with internal engineering teams and customer representatives to manage the full lifecycle of proposal from identification to approval.
Maintain organized records of all contract correspondence, modifications, and compliance documentation.
Build and maintain relationships with key customers in commercial and government organizations.
